title: shared-contracts: validateApp requires owner; pass package.json team in all 3 apps (single PR)

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty. core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner matching their package.json team. Assumptions: owner hardcoded as a literal because the inlining bundler can't import package.json; all validateApp callers were in mono (platform-kit doesn't use it), so no lib release needed; no version bump for the inlined shared-contracts lib. All 3 apps build locally; PR #1 CI and CD green.
